== Summary ==
Slip “•Your Ship?” cut unchanged from page 2 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-P.pdf Virtual Set P release sheet (updated December 2022)] (PDF file created 12 December 2022), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (69, 108, 581, 392)). Version [[Your Ship? (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Not a recreation.
